name: Matriarca da Cinza

race.name: Orc
race.bodyProfile: Robusto e de massa corporal ampla — proposta individual candidata

role: Estudo candidato de identidade Orc; Warrior como contexto de roupa, sem classe nova

appearance.face: A mature female Orc clan warrior with a massive grounded silhouette: broad powerful shoulders, deep barrel torso, strong hips, thick forearms and large work-scarred hands. A formidable square-jawed face, heavy brow, deeply set amber eyes, prominent uneven tusks and several old scars; dignified authority rather than a youthful pretty face. Deep warm moss-green skin, dark coarse hair in two thick practical braids with a few grey strands and small aged bronze rings. Fully clothed functional battle attire built from heavy faded-indigo quilted wool, a short asymmetric dark fur mantle, a structured leather torso cuirass reinforced by small ivory bone plates, layered woven hip panels, leather leg wraps and sturdy boots. Detailed hand stitching, knotted cords, engraved simple geometric bone motifs and oxidized bronze fittings. No enormous steel pauldrons, no red scarf, no shiny plate suit. Broad horizontal weight contrasted with a clear compact lower silhouette; a commanding original Orc veteran with individual character. Ivory, faded indigo, burnt umber, dark moss and aged bronze.
